name: Spear of Shards — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Spear of Shards from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Spear of Shards (Minor Artifact)" but are not part of the Spear of Shards entry, which is unchanged.

Slot none; CL 18th; Weight 10 lbs.; Aura strong divination

DESCRIPTION

This weathered spear of lightweight metal is topped with a slender shard of pale crystal that pulses with a soft amber glow. Set underneath this crystal head is a ring set with seven small teardrop-shaped crystals that glow with a similar amber light; five settings on the ring are empty. The haft is engraved with a complex pattern that seems at times to shift and reform itself.
